newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 19.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices fell on nervous selling by some players who were expecting further cuts to cargo prices. But some major maintained their offers at the higher level of $103.00 per tonne against the trade for a 2,000-tonne 380-cst cargo at $100 per tonne. Anticipation of further cuts to cargo prices also kept shipowners sidelined, traders said. In the cargo market, 180-cst was heard offered at $104.5 per tonne.
